purpose: Describe a notable event approaching or a location just behind.
keywords: N + を控えて / を控えた + N
With the exam approaching, I review every day.
It snowed on the morning just before our departure.
I visited a town with mountains rising behind it.
formation: N + を控えて / を控えた + N
restrictions: Most often used with a forthcoming event.
mistake: With a place noun it can instead describe a nearby background location.
